nodes.title: Meridian Arts Foundation
nodes.heroSubtitle: Enriching Our Community Through Art, Culture, and Creative Expression

heroDescription.processed: The Meridian Arts Foundation nurtures artistic excellence, supports emerging and established artists, and makes the arts accessible to everyone. Through exhibitions, residencies, grants, and education, we believe art has the power to transform lives and strengthen communities.

ctaDescription.processed: Your generosity fuels creativity in our community. Become a member, sponsor an exhibition, or make a donation to help us continue bringing world-class art to everyone.
